title: •Maul’s Sith Speeder
caption: Flare-S Racing Swoop (V)
game_text: May add Maul as driver. May deploy with Maul as a ‘react’. During battle, Maul may disembark (place this vehicle in Used Pile) to cancel the immunity to attrition of a Jedi here. Immune to attrition.
lore: Attain speeds of up to 600 kph. 3 meters long. Extremely difficult to control at high speeds. Dengar rode a similar swoop when injured in a race with Han at Agrilat.

heading: •Maul’s Sith Speeder (V)
notes: Sheet group: Everything else (Dark Side). COMBO CARD — TALL FULL-CARD OVERLAY (755×1099 crop) on the blue DS vehicle frame: title bar with the yellow transport-vehicle disc, title '•Maul’s Sith Speeder' (curly apostrophe), destiny 5 (unchanged). NO LORE BOX printed: the blank white art window covers the lore box and ring position — lore kept from the printed Flare-S Racing Swoop (the PC's VB5 reissue also keeps its lore and art). Banner TRANSPORT VEHICLE; stats POWER 1 / MANEUVER 6 / LANDSPEED 6; deploy 1 / forfeit 2; no scomp ring, no column icons (only the VS15 sphere). ‘react’. with the period outside the closing quote, as printed. Credits below the text box: left 'Original concept by Ryan French', right 'Seattle V-Lite 2005'. Bottom strip prints 'Flare-S Racing Swoop  (V)' with a double space before (V) — normalised to one space in caption. CHANGES vs Decipher Flare-S Racing Swoop (Special Edition): title → '•Maul’s Sith Speeder' (now UNIQUE); POWER 0 → 1, MANEUVER 5 → 6, LANDSPEED * → 6; deploy 2 → 1; forfeit 2 unchanged; game text replaced (printed: 'May add 1 driver and 1 passenger. *Landspeed = driver’s ability, and may be used at any time to follow an opponent’s vehicle or character that just moved from same site (if within range).'); banner and destiny unchanged. Slip text matches the stub. Lore matches the wiki and scan. Base SE-D-flaresracingswoop.gif (350 px only); SE copyright 1998. Modern: VB5-D-maulssithspeeder-pre.gif (350, Virtual Block 5 — a later revision: prints ARMOR 6 instead of MANEUVER 6 and a scomp ring; art only).
